اجترمت (form VIII)
# اِجْتَرَمْتُ (ijtaramtu) /id͡ʒ.ta.ram.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# اِجْتَرَمْتَ (ijtaramta) /id͡ʒ.ta.ram.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# اِجْتَرَمْتِ (ijtaramti) /id͡ʒ.ta.ram.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# اِجْتَرَمَتْ (ijtaramat) /id͡ʒ.ta.ra.mat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
